method: In systematic S1/S2 diaries and their dated continuations a missing BM entry counts as zero according to the logging convention. The older 2024 S5 checklist did not systematically track bowel frequency: an omitted entry is unknown, not zero. A recorded daily total supersedes individual entries. Explicitly uncertain, untracked or conflicting counts are excluded. Dates with no diary are excluded and are never assigned zero.
coverage: Only diary-covered dates; untracked older S5 dates are excluded. Zero by omission applies only to systematic S1/S2 diaries and their dated continuations.
source_methods: zero by omission in later systematic S1/S2 diary formats and their dated continuations; not in S5 historical checklist
